bias.zh: 看空 · 跌破 10 月低点

read.en: AAOI fell 9.5% on Nov 2 to $62.50, trading between $61.88 and $71.57, its lowest close since February. It is below the rising 5-day ($74.0) and falling 10-day ($73.2) averages, the falling 30-day ($92.5) and 100-day ($113.2) and the rising 200-day ($114.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($83.31), and RSI is 33.
read.zh: AAOI 11月2日下跌 9.5%，收于 $62.50，盘中区间 $61.88–71.57，为 2 月以来最低收盘。股价位于上行的 5 日（$74.0）和下行的 10 日均线（$73.2）下方，也低于下行的 30 日（$92.5）和 100 日均线（$113.2）以及上行的 200 日均线（$114.3）。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$83.31），RSI 为 33。

read.en: The drop broke the $65.6–66.3 support (Oct 30, Oct 22 and Feb 27 lows), now resistance. Resistance is $65.6–66.3, then $71.6–74.0 (Nov 2 high, 10 and 5-day) and $82.3–83.3 (Oct 28–29 highs, SAR). Support is $59.3 (Feb 25 high), then $50.8 (Feb 11 high). A close back above $66.3 would target $72–74; below $59.3, $51.

r.en: Oct 30, Oct 22 and Feb 27 lows ($65.6–66.3), lost
